seed_entries.note: Corrected 2026-08-25 by the traveldoc cross-check, adjudicated against the official source. Plan a trip of 14 days or less: Vietnam's Foreign Ministry list (last updated 14/3/2025) still shows 30 days, but the reported 15 July 2026 cut to 14 days is what airlines are checking, so anything longer needs a Vietnamese visa.
